headline: Colombia's CRC Updates Rules for Fiber Access and Shared Networks
summary: Colombia's Communications Regulation Commission updated fiber optic access rules to facilitate the use of existing infrastructure and reduce costs.
why: Regulatory adjustments by telecommunications authorities impact capital expenditure requirements and profit margins for telecom operators.

impacts.name: Telecommunications
impacts.why: Shared infrastructure rules can lower network deployment costs for internet service providers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
